title: Colour Designer 1, Footwear
note: Footwear color and materials (CMF) for outdoor footwear.

facts.summary: Footwear colour designer who turns seasonal direction into colour palettes.
facts.duties: Builds colour palettes and colour expressions for footwear, researches trends, and makes presentations with merchandisers.
facts.requirements: Design degree, strong colour sense, Illustrator and Creative Suite skills.
